title: Richard Burns Rally (RallySimFans) stage names
keys: The stage key is rbr:<map id>, the id the NGP telemetry sends as stage.index. A stage not listed (a custom one added later) is shown as 'RBR stage <id>' with the length the packet gives, or named from the player's own install where Oversteer finds it.
notes: Facts only (id, name, length in m, surface and its shares, country code), read once from a RallySimFans install: rsfdata/cache/stages_data.json and Maps/Tracks.ini, 2026-10-26; built by research/rbr/stage_table.py. Lengths are RSF's, mostly rounded to 100 m; the packet's driveline length is the exact one.
